2225-7507-7874-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-7507-7874-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-653-2511.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-653-2511.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2486-4694-5226-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4694-5226-7306.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

240-2079-3899-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

411-4103-4613-7388.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-4103-4613-7388.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Yidaro enters the battlefield, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yidaro.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

4321-4559-5147-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
4321-4559-5147-7839.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Peregrin Took.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

4186-4268-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4268-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-5147-5434.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6968-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6968-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

4325-5540-7512.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an artifact, creature, or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
An opponent controls an artifact.
If you are going to have a nonartifact creature or enchantment enter the battlefield, an opponent must also control either a creature or enchantment respectively.
4325-5540-7512.description:
Cause an artifact, creature or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the permanent that entered with an opponent for another permanent of the same type.
Zidane triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the Treasure with an opponent for another artifact.
Repeat from step 3.
4325-5540-7512.notes: Stony Silence prevents the opponents from sacrificing the Treasures for mana. Without it, your opponents can sacrifice the Treasures and stop you (eventually) from exchanging control of artifacts.

5071-7439.description:
Cast a copy of Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Comet Storm by paying {R}{R} and all remaining available mana, dealing a large amount of damage to a set number of targets.
5071-7439.notes: The more life you have, the more damage you will deal. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Comet Storm. Comet Storm's multikicker can be used to add targets as needed.

7-457-1458-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
7-457-1458-4404.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
7-457-1458-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Hamza.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-7374-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by The Lost and the Damned
1618-2440-7374-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
The Lost and the Damned triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-7374-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by The Lost and the Damned. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

140-4217-7101.notablePrerequisites: You've lost 2 or more life this turn.
140-4217-7101.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Rowan.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Rowan.
Repeat from step 4.

1719-2628-6185-7206.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
1719-2628-6185-7206.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1719-2628-6185-7206.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it due to New Perspectives.
Escape Protocol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbing Sands trigger, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Reoslve the Escape Protocol trigger, blinking Dundoolin Weaver.
When Dundoolin Weaver enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vizier of Tumbing Sands from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

725-1329-3661-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Shield Sphere, adding {R}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Shield Sphere, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

3215-4779-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4779-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-3028-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1308-3028-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Vital Force
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

3490-3499-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3499-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

380-2726-2972-4365.description:
Cast Miirym either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{G}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Miirym spell, creating two token copies of Miirym.
Put all but one legendary Miirym into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Miirym tokens enter, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Miirym spell. Choose to put the nontoken Miirym into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Miirym you control and Ganax trigger,
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve a Miirym trigger, creating two token copies of Miirym that aren't legendary.
When the Miirym tokens enter, Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 8 for each remaining trigger, if applicable.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 11 until you control no Treasures and/or you have enough mana to cast Miirym from the command zone.
Repeat from step 1.
380-2726-2972-4365.notes: The starting cost assume you haven't cost Miirym from the command zone this game. You can perform the combo if you've cast Miirym this game from the command zone, but will need additional mana to do so.

152-2034-5446-5921.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariot token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
152-2034-5446-5921.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

500-2081-2187.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Possessed Skaab and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Possessed Skaab tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-1563-2457-4927.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

573-1339-1479-6674.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
573-1339-1479-6674.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Kodama and Rydia trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rydia trigger, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Rydia trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1445-4871-5147-6351.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5147-6351.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

185-771-1031-2276-6229.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Mystic Retrieval or Said // Done must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
185-771-1031-2276-6229.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Mystic Retrieval without paying its mana cost, targeting Said
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Mystic Retrieval, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, causing you to return Said and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Said without paying its mana cost, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Said, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Saids, causing you to return Mystic Retrieval and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.

997-3951-4875-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
997-3951-4875-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1617-4831-4983-5358-5487.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Molten Duplication.
1617-4831-4983-5358-5487.description:
Cast Molten Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5358-5487.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

565-2909-4600-6203.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Blue"
565-2909-4600-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast blue monocolored spells.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Throne of Eldraine.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Blue" as its color as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

2082-5189-5231.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to a creature you control.
2082-5189-5231.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2082-5189-5231.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {R}.
When the Saproling dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Repeat.

2440-5090-5663.easyPrerequisites: Singing Bell Strike attached to Cayth.
2440-5090-5663.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
You control at least seven creatures that share a creature type with the creature token.
Cayth does not have summoning sickness.
2440-5090-5663.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with it.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Cayth.
Repeat.
2440-5090-5663.notes: You may begin the combo with less creatures that share a type with the token, but you will need additional mana to do so until you begin to break even from Mana Echoes' trigger. Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Cayth to get infinite proliferate.

293-2292-5220-5716.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

500-4867-4872.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one Cormela token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the original Cormela and the token Cormela die, their abilities trigger, returning Time Warp and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1543-2032-3263-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Kiora has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
1543-2032-3263-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Kiora.
Activate Kiora by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3384-4067-4135.notablePrerequisites:
Tablet of Compleation has at least five oil counters on it.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
3384-4067-4135.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Tablet of Compleation's third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Tablet of Compleation and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.

2584-4186-5017.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
2584-4186-5017.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium, dealing 1 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.

1071-2988-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
1071-2988-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 100 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

474-1056-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
You have an additional card in your graveyard for each opponent you have.
Araumi does not have summoning sickness.
474-1056-4050.description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling a number of cards equal to the number of opponent you have, giving Specimen Collector encore until end of turn.
Activate Specimen Collector's encore ability by paying {4}{U} and exiling it, creating at least two token copies of it with haste.
Each Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, creating that many 1/1 Squirrel and 0/3 Crab creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Specimen Collector token, adding one mana of any color.
The Specimen Collector token dies, creating a token copy of a Specimen Collector token.
Repeat from step 3.

618-2493-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste.
The token copy of Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1447-4050-4192.notablePrerequisites: "Human" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
1447-4050-4192.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Glory's Rise, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, then returning all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-2190.notablePrerequisites:
Triskelion has at least two +1/+1 counters.
You have a way to give Triskelion deathtouch.
1495-2190.description:
Give Triskelion deathtouch.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Vraska triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat from step 2.

1671-4222-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Ley Druid.
1671-4222-4348.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
